langs.description: Human language(s) of this record's text fields, as BCP-47 language tags (e.g. 'es', 'pt-BR'); up to three for mixed-language text. Set by the writing app from the text the author wrote, with the author able to correct it; never from the interface language or a profile preference alone. A hint for readers, not a guarantee: consumers must not hide a record because it lacks this field.

avatar.description: Small image to be displayed next to posts from account. AKA, 'profile picture'. Clients crop it to a square or circle, so an organization should use its brandmark (the symbol without the name); the full logo belongs in app.certified.actor.organization logo.

banner.description: Larger horizontal image to display behind profile view.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.

displayName.description: Display name for the account. For an organization, the public-facing name it uses in communications; a different registered legal name belongs in app.certified.actor.organization legalName.

main.description: A declaration of a Certified account profile.
